reviewed_by: Codex review of nebula-v3.0.14 native command release failure
reason: The v3.0.14 real-Core gate exposed native command parsing of appended Core instructions, stale Guides and top-bar action entry under Quiet Lens, and fourteen real-Core journeys that still assumed an older navigation shell. A separate goal-panel release failure used an opener that a responsive rerender had already replaced with the open panel. Select the focused command unit file, production LAN real-Core commands and Guides on desktop and 390 px Chromium/WebKit, Quiet Lens mock journeys on desktop and mobile Chromium/WebKit, the fourteen exact failing real-Core desktop journeys, and the three goal-panel revision cases. The shared AppShell and TopBar impact was reviewed against their rendered menu workflow.
exclusions: No focused component test covers the shell menu interaction and no native source changed, so frontend unit and native selections are empty; the real-Core and mock browser journeys exercise the rendered state. Unrelated browser and backend journeys are excluded. The selected browser entries collect thirty cases; a full suite was not requested.
